title.en: AIE study visit to Seattle and Boise

summary.en: Selected by the AIE program to take part in a study visit to Seattle, Washington, and Boise, Idaho, which included visits to the [University of Washington](https://www.washington.edu/about/seattle-campus/), [Google](https://www.google.com/about/careers/applications/locations/seattle-kirkland-bellevue-redmond/), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/locations/hq1), [Microsoft](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/locations/seattle-area.html), the [Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)](https://allenai.org/contact), and [Micron](https://www.micron.com/about/careers/idaho).
